meta.name: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
meta.description: Buggy, luego de ser derrotado por Luffy, Zoro y Nami, empieza su contienda por recuperar sus partes del cuerpo y su tripulación, para poder tener su vistoza venganza contra Luffy.

videos.title: The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
videos.overview: Buggy, after being defeated by Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, begins his quest to regain his body parts and his crew, and then he will get his flashy revenge on Luffy.
